facts.content: A region passes only with completion >= 95%, open Sev-1 = 0, open Sev-2 <= 2, and support capacity / projected peak load >= 1.25.
Every gate is applied per region; portfolio averages cannot substitute for a failed regional gate.
A phased launch may proceed when at least one region passes all gates, but only passing regions may launch.
The decision uses evidence finalized by 2026-08-31 18:00 UTC.
The preliminary table lists Central with two Sev-2 issues and East with zero Sev-1 issues.
The final table on page 3 supersedes the preliminary table on page 2 and is the evidence finalized at the cutoff.
North: 97% completion, zero open Sev-1, one open Sev-2.
Central: 96% completion, zero open Sev-1, three open Sev-2.
West: 94% completion, zero open Sev-1, zero open Sev-2.
East: 98% completion, one open Sev-1, zero open Sev-2.
North has support capacity 137 and projected peak load 108; the formula ratio is 1.2685.
Central has support capacity 150 and projected peak load 117; the formula ratio is 1.2821.
West has support capacity 150 and projected peak load 100; the formula ratio is 1.5000.
East has support capacity 180 and projected peak load 130; the formula ratio is 1.3846.
The portfolio dashboard displays GO because it aggregates completion and issue counts instead of applying all gates per region.
